title: 幫我砍一刀
mood: chaotic, greedy and stuck at ninety-nine point nine
subject: begging everyone in your contacts to tap 'cut once' on a shopping app's free air fryer, stuck at 99.9 percent for three days
caption: Chinese hyperpop and 土嗨 glitch-pop in the style of DJ Gurl's county-town club collage. Over-compressed, distorted 808s that clip on every hit; bitcrushed supersaw chords; stutter and glitch edits on the synths and drums at the end of each phrase; old instant-messenger notification blips and dial-up modem noise used as percussion; drums that switch hard between a pounding club four-on-the-floor kick and trap hi-hat rolls, with bursts of static between sections. Loud, crushed and in-your-face, the low end blown out and narrow, the voice dry and forward. Female voice, high and bright with hard digital pitch correction, rapping the verses fast and flat, shouting the chorus like a county-fair MC with audible breaths, and a small crowd shouting the one-word answers. 160 BPM, F-sharp minor. Chaotic, greedy and stuck at ninety-nine point nine. No clean eurodance, no acoustic guitar, no ballad piano, no smooth R&B, no rock band, no straight trap beat in the choruses, no pitched-up voice samples, no chopped-up voice snippets.
lyrics:
[Intro - short, static burst, message-tone blips, one distorted 808 hit]

[Verse 1 - fast rap]
半夜一點 跳出一個紅色視窗
免費領一台氣炸鍋 只要朋友幫你砍
第一刀 砍掉一半 我從床上坐起來
第二刀 砍了九成 我打開了通訊錄

[Pre-Chorus]
高中同學 前同事 賣保險的阿姨
連我媽的牌友 我都傳了一遍

[Chorus - shouted, crowd answers]
幫我砍一刀 (砍!)
家人們 幫我砍一刀 (砍!)
九十九點九 九十九點九
就差一點點 一點點 一點點

[Verse 2 - fast rap]
第三天 進度條 還卡在九十九點九
兩百個人砍過了 每一刀 都砍在小數點後面
我前任回了一句 妳最近還好嗎
我說很好 幫我砍一刀

[Beat Switch - trap hats, glitch stutter, static]
還差零點零零一
系統說 請再邀請一位新用戶

[Chorus - shouted, crowd answers]
幫我砍一刀 (砍!)
樓下賣早餐的大叔 也幫我砍一刀 (砍!)
九十九點九 九十九點九
整條街都砍過了 還是九十九點九

[Outro - static burst, then one message-tone blip]
後來我去超市 自己買了一台
八十九塊 還送一盒雞蛋
